note: Static policy RECOMMENDATION published by the ML block. The per-request ml_prediction contract carries the FORECAST and the inputs needed to act (confidence, expected_return, signal_context, as_of). This file is the static POLICY on how to act on those forecasts. risk_manager owns the final decision and may override. This is NOT returned inside ml_prediction — it is delivered as a versioned spec.

global.skip_weekend_sessions_reason: MOEX weekend sessions (introduced 2025) are thin; the model has no edge there (validation: Sunday cluster negative).

validated_backtest_weekday_only.basis: walk-forward validation (2023-07..2025); out-of-sample test gate PENDING
